title: Hanuman Ansh
synopsis: Longing to meet his departed mother, a grieving boy seeks God. His spiritual journey leads him to serve humanity through selfless love and blessings, eventually becoming the revered Neem Karoli Baba.

synopsis_lang.en: Longing to meet his departed mother, a grieving boy seeks God. His spiritual journey leads him to serve humanity through selfless love and blessings, eventually becoming the revered Neem Karoli Baba.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 一名悲慟的少年渴望再見已逝的母親，因而踏上尋覓神的旅程。在靈性追尋中，他透過無私的愛與祝福來服務眾生，最終成為備受敬仰的尼姆·卡羅里·巴巴（Neem Karoli Baba）。
